# Portability and Identity Requirements Checklist: Embed Specimen Logo

**Purpose**: Review whether S034 requirements completely and unambiguously define specimen self-containment, identity preservation, rendered evidence, and publication equivalence
**Created**: 2026-09-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are portability requirements defined for both `href` and `xlink:href`, including embedded payloads and internal fragments? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001–FR-003]
- [ ] CHK002 Are authoritative source bytes, media type, geometry, placement, proportions, colors, and transparency all covered by explicit preservation requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004–FR-005]
- [ ] CHK003 Are direct browser navigation, offline local opening, and repository SVG-renderer paths all required for the exact production specimen? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK004 Are downloadable-kit and hosted-file copies both included in the equivalence requirement? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK005 Are production verification, glyph validation, site validation, browser coverage, identity checks, and repository hygiene all included in the completion gate? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014–FR-016]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is “self-contained” limited to `data:` payloads or internal fragment references and does it unambiguously exclude relative, filesystem, and network dependencies? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002–FR-003]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the permitted transformation exception constrained to transformations already authorized by the governed source contract? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the “exact generated specimen” distinguished from hand-authored fixtures and substituted assets? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK009 Is visible mark output objectively defined through non-background pixels inside the declared mark region? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, §SC-003]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK010 Do embedding requirements preserve the same source-byte boundary required by the identity requirements without implying decoded SVG rewriting? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, §FR-004–FR-005]
- [ ] CHK011 Do publication equivalence requirements align with the rule that the site consumes verified generated kits? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, §Dependencies]
- [ ] CHK012 Do synthetic regression requirements remain consistent with the prohibition on production discovery, publication, and committed fixtures? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, §FR-012]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK013 Can every output reference, decoded source payload, rendered mark region, and publication copy be measured without subjective visual judgment? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001–SC-005]
- [ ] CHK014 Are zero-problem and zero-failure production gates stated as exact, independently reportable outcomes? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006–SC-007]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK015 Are invalid or empty embedded payloads addressed separately from syntactically valid SVG and successful HTTP status? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, User Story 3]
- [ ] CHK016 Are media-type variation, URI encoding, dual link attributes, internal fragments, and renderer variation covered without expanding identity scope? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the failure behavior specified for unresolved references and for an invisible rendered mark region? [Exception Flow, Spec §FR-008–FR-009]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the successful offline path explicit enough to prove the specimen has no neighboring-file dependency? [Recovery/Offline, Spec §User Story 1]

## Dependencies and Boundaries

- [ ] CHK019 Are governed source resolution and safe publication paths treated as the relevant security boundary while authentication and tenancy remain explicitly inapplicable? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK020 Are generated-output patching, identity changes, unrelated site behavior, release publication, and git push explicitly excluded? [Scope, Spec §Out of Scope]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
